annotations.title: Buscar telefone do sócio pelo CNPJ

description: For Brazilian companies, finds the partner or administrator listed in the company's public partner registry (Receita Federal) by its CNPJ, and looks up that person's own mobile phone (personal data). Takes 1 to 25 entries in people, looked up 5 at a time. Each company is identified by its CNPJ; the partner's LinkedIn profile or e-mail, when known, help confirm the person. First it checks this workspace (people sheets, campaigns and kept briefs): a value already saved comes back free, with savedIn naming where it was saved; refresh true skips that check. Otherwise it asks Nock's data sources one after another and stops at the first that finds it. value is the partner's mobile number, checked against the registry's owner of the line as phoneOwner (confirmed or unconfirmed); a number of someone else is dropped and not charged (phonesDiscarded). A number found for a person of this workspace's campaigns or people sheets is written into that person's empty phone field (prospectId, or sheetId with rowId), and savedTo says where. Returns one entry per person or business in the order sent (index), each with person (whose it is), status found, not_found or error, value and creditsCharged, plus the totals found, notFound, failed and creditsCharged. not_found with sourcesUnanswered means some sources did not answer in time and a later try may find it; error means no source answered. The same entry sent twice is looked up once (sameAsIndex). Costs 20 credits per value found. Nothing is charged when it is not found, the lookup fails or the value was already saved. A lookup can take up to about a minute per entry.

people.description: Who to look up, 1 to 25 entries, each with what is known of them.

cnpj.description: The company's CNPJ (Brazilian company registry number). Its partner registry says who the partner is.

linkedinUrl.description: The partner's LinkedIn profile URL, when known.

prospectId.description: The campaign prospect this lookup is for, when known: a mobile found is saved to them.

rowId.description: The sheet row this lookup is for, with sheetId: a mobile found is saved to its phone column.

sheetId.description: The people sheet of the row this lookup is for, with rowId.

refresh.description: True skips what this workspace has saved and looks the value up outside again.
